contract.persistence: Only signed JWT-owned documents in the PostgreSQL metadata profile persist validated Q&A turns. Guest/capability questions remain ephemeral.
contract.lifecycle: Turns are linked to the current reading fingerprint, are cleared on successful reread, and are deleted through document lifecycle cascade/expiry.
contract.privacy: Turns are saved only after answer validation and guardrails; provider requests, prompts, vectors, credentials, capabilities, and raw provider responses are not persisted.

verification.backend: Full offline backend pytest suite passed; Ruff check and format check passed; strict mypy passed for 45 source files.
verification.frontend: TypeScript type check, ESLint, Prettier check, and Next.js production build passed.
verification.live_durable_profile: Not run in this work unit. A PostgreSQL/MinIO/JWT environment must be configured and migration 20260920_0004 applied before signed persistence can be exercised live.
